changes.comment: Remove the dead `turn.ts` module (`InboundTurnInput` / `InboundAttachment`). These shapes stopped crossing the Agent Runtime seam when Channel rendering moved into each runtime, and they were deliberately withheld from the package root export, so they had no consumer in any package and no external provider author could name them. Deleting them changes no published type: the root export surface is unchanged, and the root-export guard now asserts the carve-out is gone rather than locking it in place.
